entry_condition: Review completed controlled fixed_lr/entropy/both continuations first. Submit only if they fail to produce reliable balanced insertion and corrected current-qpos evaluation remains unsolved.
question: Does a historical-inspired dense log-distance objective with a strong held-three success incentive improve learning under the corrected equal-inertia current-physical-state benchmark?
interpretation: The two profiles change dense shaping and success-bonus magnitude together; this is an objective-profile comparison, not a pure shaping ablation or an exact historical reproduction. It does not establish why historical runs succeeded.
source_requirement: Commit and freeze the complete repair source before submission; base revision does not include these prepared uncommitted additions. Do not modify any running source checkout.
fairness: Both cases start fresh with seed0 N512, GRU128 and128x96 RGB, view7, clean occlusion,3.5s horizon and.04s control, equal variant inertias, current-qpos held-three success, initialstd.4 and identical adaptive3e-4/.003 entropy PPO. Existing progress model_99 trained under derived_substep cannot be the corrected baseline.

evaluation.media: Capture first success/failure per variant from the evaluated trajectory; no physics replay.
evaluation.selection: Do not select on untouched test episodes. Do not claim episode-perfect causal pairing from reset seed: identical initial states previously diverged on GPU.

stage2_if_evidence_supports.method: Extend both cases at matched budgets when the100-update screen is sparse/inconclusive but learning/optimization is healthy; preserve each saved profile/initialstd/W&B identity. Stop expansion to diagnose nonfinite losses, exploration collapse or physically invalid success. Never change profile or std during resume.
stage2_if_evidence_supports.quality_gate: Reward alone cannot establish repair. Inspect episode-weighted training success, corrected balanced validation and each variant, terminal errors/hold, LR/KL/per-axis std/value loss, and repeat variability before considering3-seed replication.

initial_std_followup: The CLI also supports std1.0 as a separately labeled fresh experiment motivated by historical metadata. Keep std.4 in this first pair to avoid conflating objective and exploration.
resource_bound: At most2 new training GPUs for this pair; total concurrent training<=4. Recheck Slurm/manifests before submission and reserve manifests atomically. Measured prior short-stage runtimes suggest minutes per100-update case, but no duration promise is made for the new reward.
